steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each plan item is placed by its baseline and the volume behind it.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 2 targets need a baseline or a measure

findings.title: Target with no baseline
findings.fix: Record last year's actual as the baseline

findings.title: Service level with no measure
findings.fix: Name the measure and its source

findings.title: Channel in the plan with no volume

outcome.notChecked: Market or product changes not in the notes.
